name: ASOS
description: Dresses, denim, occasionwear and trend-led separates across multiple labels.
tip: Compare the measurements and fit notes for each brand rather than assuming every label fits alike.

name: Zalando
description: A broad starting point for clothing, footwear, accessories and sportswear.
tip: Use category and brand filters to narrow the selection before comparing individual garments.

name: Zara
description: Seasonal womenswear, tailoring, dresses and accessories.
tip: Look closely at fabric composition, garment measurements and the cut of the shoulder or waist.

name: H&M
description: Everyday basics, knitwear, denim and occasion pieces.
tip: Choose the destination country before checking stock, prices and delivery.

name: Mango
description: Tailoring, knitwear, dresses and coordinated wardrobe pieces.
tip: Compare how a piece works with your existing wardrobe, not just its campaign styling.

name: UNIQLO
description: Layering basics, knitwear, shirts, trousers and functional everyday clothing.
tip: Check fabric weight and fit information when choosing a base layer or everyday knit.

name: COS
description: Modern tailoring, knitwear and clothing with an emphasis on shape.
tip: Notice the intended volume and length: an oversized design is different from the wrong size.

name: & Other Stories
description: Womenswear, dresses, knitwear, shoes and finishing accessories.
tip: Consider fabric and care instructions alongside the look of the garment.

name: NET-A-PORTER
description: A multi-designer destination for womenswear, footwear and accessories.
tip: Compare designer sizing and the specific seller terms for your delivery destination.

name: Oysho
description: Sportswear, athleisure and swimwear in a range of activity-led categories.
tip: Match the fabric and support to the activity, then check the local store for delivery.

name: Calzedonia
description: Swimwear and beachwear alongside tights, socks and legwear.
tip: Check the cut, lining and whether two-piece components can be selected separately.

name: Decathlon
description: Swimming and activity-focused swimwear, including pool one-pieces and two-pieces.
tip: Choose according to swimming frequency, intended activity and the product specifications.

name: Speedo
description: A swimming-focused destination for swimsuits and related swim products.
tip: Read the individual suit’s fabric, fit and intended-use information.
